description: This file defines a Google Mock class template for mocking the IStringIterator interface within a testing context, specifically for the Thunder project in the network manager module.

classes.name: MockStringIterator
classes.description: A mock class template for the IStringIterator interface, used for unit testing components that depend on this interface.

methods.name: Next
methods.description: Mocks the method to advance to the next element in the iterator.

methods.name: Previous
methods.description: Mocks the method to go back to the previous element in the iterator.

methods.name: Reset
methods.description: Mocks the method to reset the iterator to a specific position.

methods.name: IsValid
methods.description: Mocks the method to check if the current iterator position is valid.

methods.name: Count
methods.description: Mocks the method to get the total number of elements.

methods.name: Current
methods.description: Mocks the method to retrieve the current element.

methods.name: AddRef
methods.description: Mocks the method to increase the reference count.

methods.name: Release
methods.description: Mocks the method to decrease the reference count.

methods.name: QueryInterface
methods.description: Mocks the method for interface querying.
